area.sourceLabel: City of Spruce Grove on-demand page and its stop map
area.serviceHours: Spruce Grove: Monday to Friday 5 a.m. to 7 p.m.; Saturday 8 a.m. to 10 p.m.; Sunday 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Stony Plain: Monday to Friday 5 a.m. to 7 p.m.; Saturday 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. Parkland Village and Acheson: Monday to Friday 5 to 9 a.m. and 2:15 to 6:15 p.m.
area.hoursNote: No service on general holidays (the City lists them on its on-demand page).
area.bookingInfo: Book in the Book My Bus app, at book.mybus.rideco.com or call 780-962-8747, right away or up to one week ahead.
